# Rule: Calling convention macro undefined after use

_Canonical rule slug:_ `calling-convention-macro-undefined-after-use`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> An exported function's calling convention changes through a convention macro that the header undefines right after the declaration, so the macro is absent from the final preprocessor state.
